free_tier.stated: Nostr Media has no free tier.

per_object_cap.stated: 5 GB per file on every tier.

retention.stated: Uploads never expire while the subscription is active.

egress.terms: unmetered, Cloudflare-fronted (Server: cloudflare, Cache-Control public max-age=14400).

interface_detail: NIP-96 HTTP file storage. Discoverable at /.well-known/nostr/nip96.json; POST /upload; /presigned 'handles up to 5 GB'.
tooling: curl; NIP-98 Authorization header (signed event). The llms.txt documents the /presigned path for large objects.
chaining: Machine-readable plan manifest means the cap is queryable rather than scraped. One GET tells you the size ceiling per plan.
limits_note: Per-object-cap 25 MiB free. 125 MB on the direct /upload, 5 GB via /presigned (per llms.txt). The /presigned path is the one that matters and it is far above the free plan's advertised 25 MiB.

identity_cost.detail: Subscriptions are tied to a Nostr public key, not to an email address.

reliability_note: Transforms media at ingest on some paths (resizing, format_conversion, compression, metadata_stripping are all listed in the manifest). Verify that originals come back byte-identical.
confidence_note: the pricing page states there is no free tier and an active subscription is required

evidence.proved: literal body: api_url https://nostrmedia.com/upload, download_url https://file.nostrmedia.com, supported_nips [94,96,98], plans.free.max_byte_size 26214400, file_expiration [0,0], media_transformations image [resizing, format_conversion, compression, metadata_stripping]
'A single POST to /upload accepts files up to 125 MB; /presigned handles up to 5 GB', 'Uploads never expire while the subscription is active'
'/upload answers 413 above 125 MB because the request would outlive the worker'
the pricing page is the source that states no free tier
evidence.quote: Nostr Media has no free tier.

evidence.proved: the stated 5 GB ceiling converts to 5,000,000,000 bytes
evidence.quote: Per-file ceiling on every tier is 5 GB.

evidence.proved: the llms.txt page is the source that states the retention
evidence.quote: Uploads never expire while the subscription is active.

evidence.proved: a subscription is keyed to a Nostr public key, not an email address
evidence.quote: Subscriptions are tied to a Nostr public key, not to an email address.

evidence.proved: an active paid subscription is required to upload or store files
evidence.quote: An active subscription is required to upload or store files.

notes: An active subscription is required to upload or store files.

extras.unit_note: free_tier.unit is 'mixed' because the headline is denominated in MiB or KiB, which the schema enum does not carry; the verbatim free_tier.stated keeps the true unit.
